notes.title: Update 1.71
notes.notes:
[u][b]Minor changes to the keyboard shortcuts.[/b][/u]

Press the '[b]Caps Lock[/b]' button to enter sprint mode. You can get out of this mode by pressing the '[b]CTRL[/b]' key.

Press the '[b]C[/b]' button to switch to target mode. You can get out of this mode by pressing the '[b]right mouse button[/b]'.

You can switch the control mode with the '[b]V[/b]‘ key.

'[b]-[/b]' Show FPS

'[b]T[/b]' Crosshair (dot) always visible On/Off

'F1' Difficulty select

'B' Screenshot view

'F2' Prevents you from switching to highscore mode

Press the 'F8' key to load the most important settings. these are crosshair always visible, aim mode, field of view 110, always run.

New crosshair added.

notes.title: Alternative control added!
notes.notes:
If you are not used to the controls, you now have the option of switching to the classic TPS controls. Press the V key on the keyboard to activate or deactivate it.

[previewyoutube=SX0RQ_Z2Yoo;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Addendum:[/b][/u] I have set the classic control as the default. The game therefore starts with this type of control and does not have to be selected separately.

notes.title: Update 1.68
notes.notes:
To accommodate our customers, we have made the game entry a little more user-friendly. In addition, power-ups are now dropped by enemies and can be collected. Generally points amount increased. The enemy AI has been adjusted slightly and the enemies are now generally a little stronger. Furthermore, a bug has been fixed where you could be attacked during a sequence.
